{{Quote|I am Chewbacca, son of Attichitcuk.|Chewbacca|<ref name="Comic">[[Star Wars: Chewbacca (2000)|''Star Wars: Chewbacca'' (2000)]]</ref>}}
[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] '''family''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] clan that lived in [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]]. This clan brought to the galaxy many exceptional warriors, skilled pilots and even a Jedi Knight. They had many arguments with other families.<ref name="Comic" />

==Family tree==
{{FamilyTree/start|summary=Attichitcuk had two siblings, one of whom had Jowdrrl, Shoran, and Dryanta as children, and the other of whom was the parent of Tarfful. Attichitcuk had two children, a son named Chewbacca and a daughter named Kallabow. Kallabow married Mahraccor and they were the parents of Lowbacca and Sirrakuk. Chewbacca married Mallatobuck and they had a son named Lumpawaroo.}}

==Behind the scenes==
In [[The Star Wars 7|''The Star Wars'' 7]], Chewbacca's family is identified as the "Sawa tribe", one of the most powerful Wookiee tribes, whose father (here spelled as "Auzituck") is a prince. In [[The Star Wars 8|''The Star Wars'' 8]], however, the family is referred to as "the great [[Chewbacca's family/Legends|Kaapauku]] tribe".<ref name="eight">[[The Star Wars 8|''The Star Wars'' 8]]</ref> In [[The Star Wars rough draft|''The Star Wars: Rough Draft'']], the tribe was called "Kaapauku."<ref name="THRD">[[The Star Wars rough draft|''The Star Wars'' rough draft]]</ref>
